notes:
Background: mid-market SaaS (knowledge base / enterprise search) selling to legal and finance verticals. Heavy emphasis on accuracy + inline snippet ranking. Customer quote: "Need embeddings at scale but can't absorb runaway costs — want predictable per-day spend for nightly reindex."

POC specifics & asks:
- Primary workload: nightly batch embed job (~6M docs monthly, peak window 02:00-05:00 UTC), incremental updates throughout day (100k/day).
- Target latency: embedding generation for batch doesn't need single-digit ms, but throughput must sustain 10k embeddings/min during batch window; vector search latency target for UI < 50ms p95 for 10–20 qps during working hours.
- Integration: prototyping with Pinecone as vector store; evaluating moving connector to Redwood routing -> dedicated GPU for embed generation + webhook to push to vector DB.
- Desired features: automatic batching, resumeable batch jobs, backpressure metrics, per-route token/cost breakdowns for finance reporting.
